title: SourceConcept search expansion and evidence UI
summary: Adds read-only SourceConcept alias expansion through SourceConceptSearchIndex.
Adds media-detail SourceConcept grouping, evidence preview, unconfirmed/source-layer labeling, and disabled promotion preview.
Adds search-result expansion explanations and conservative needs_review hints.
Fixes reviewer P1/P2 issues by omitting public concept keys, invalidating search cache after SourceConcept writes, and using uncapped concept ids for actual filtering.
Preserves normal tag search and F6 q= chip behavior.
Does not create or mutate Entity truth paths, TagTranslation, media_tags, providers, LLMs, source storage, iCloud, or app-managed storage.

search_semantics.active_default: Active SourceConcept aliases can expand matching q terms as an OR inside the term.
search_semantics.multi_term: Existing AND semantics across query terms are preserved.
search_semantics.negative: Negative terms remain bounded by negating the same expanded term condition.
search_semantics.quoted: Quoted/exact terms stay one parser token and can match one exact alias search key.
search_semantics.needs_review: needs_review concepts do not expand by default; they produce hints unless include_source_needs_review=1 is explicitly supplied.
search_semantics.normal_tag_priority: Normal tag search remains intact and SourceConcept expansion only adds transparent source-layer matches.

next_step: Open a normal PR, trigger @codex review, and stop. Do not start DOC1 or the Entity bridge.
